title: internal/cli tests that never configure a factory read the operator's real ~/.ticfacrc through newCloudClient
body: During development, a code path that asked the factory for any run id made TestWatchNamesARunThatNeverRanHere issue a REAL HTTP request to the operator's live factory (which answered a real 404) — the test never sets HOME, so factory.LoadCredentials read the operator's actual credentials. The committed code now asks the factory only for run_+hex-shaped ids, which local-shaped tests never produce, but the hazard remains for any future command that reaches newCloudClient on a test path without configureCloudFactory: a test can silently spend the operator's factory. A harness-level guard (blanket HOME default or a test-mode client refusal) would make it impossible.
